## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle polemical question-and-answer companion to Zhūhóng's *Fāyǐn* sub-commentary ([KR6k0086](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0086)). 問辯 *wènbiàn* "questions and disputations" indicates the genre — a defence of the principal commentary against potential objections.

**Abstract**

The *wènbiàn* preserves Zhūhóng's responses to questions and objections about his interpretation of the *Fànwǎng* precepts. Such polemical-defensive companion texts are characteristic of the late-Míng intellectual culture, in which doctrinal positions were frequently contested through formal Q&A exchanges. The disputed points include the relationship of the bodhisattva-precepts to the *prātimokṣa*, the requirements for the conferral of bodhisattva-precepts on lay practitioners, and the doctrinal status of the *Fànwǎng jīng* given its disputed authenticity.
